text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: {Hand} [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (One of your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.) [On Play] [When Digivolving] Return 1 of your opponent's Digimon with as many or fewer digivolution cards as this Digimon to the bottom of the deck. [End of Attack] [Once Per Turn] Unsuspend this Digimon. Then, if [Imperialdramon: Dragon Mode] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, return 1 of your opponent's suspended Digimon to the bottom of the deck.

text_sections.label: Special Rule
text_sections.text: ＜Overflow (-4)＞ (As this card moves from the battle area or under a card to another area, lose 4 memory.)
